reason: The README primarily presents a progressive, interactive educational guide to DeepSeek Harness plugin development, supported by an installable TypeScript example and lifecycle, testing, packaging, and replay demonstrations.

summaries.zh: 这是一个通过可安装的 TypeScript 示例和交互式阅读器讲解 DeepSeek Harness 插件开发、生命周期、测试与发布流程的教程插件。
summaries.en: An educational plugin that teaches DeepSeek Harness plugin development through an installable TypeScript example and an interactive guide covering lifecycle, testing, packaging, and replay.

capabilities: Provides a progressive tutorial on developing DeepSeek Harness plugins
Includes an installable TypeScript example exposing a greet tool
Demonstrates plugin lifecycle, service composition, session logging, replay, testing, and packaging
Provides a local interactive preview reader and command-line validation workflows
